args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was about 0.18 at time of check). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback reported success in all three regions with v2.3.0 now serving. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health checks recover on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release that was failing health checks. v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy too, but it only ran in staging.
- **Before the rollback:** All regions were on v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an error rate of about 0.18.
- **After the rollback:** The tool reported v2.3.0 as rolled out in all three regions. I did not re-check status afterward, so recovery is not yet confirmed.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, and the follow-up items.

Next steps: confirm that health checks and error rate recover on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before anything is re-released.
